name: Push Up
instructions: Keep your body straight, lower yourself until your chest nearly touches the floor, then push back up.

name: Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, squat down keeping your back straight, then return to standing.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold your body in a straight line with your elbows under your shoulders and core tight.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent at 90 degrees, then push back up.

name: Burpees
instructions: Drop into a squat, kick your feet back into a plank, return to squat, then jump up.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in a plank and run your knees toward your chest alternately.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet out and raise arms overhead, then return to start.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Lift the bar from the ground by standing up while keeping your back straight and core tight.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench and press the barbell upward until arms are extended.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping elbows close to your body.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Lower your body off the edge of a bench by bending your elbows, then push back up.

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Press dumbbells upward from shoulder height until arms are extended overhead.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your shoulders off the floor using your abdominal muscles.

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit on the floor, twist your torso from side to side, touching the floor beside you.

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie down and lift your legs while keeping them straight and together.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place while lifting your knees as high as possible.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, lift hips off the ground by squeezing your glutes.

name: Jump Squats
instructions: Perform a squat and jump explosively, landing softly and returning to squat.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on one side and lift your body up on one elbow, keeping your body in a straight line.
